rules: Every TAG must resolve to all applicable clause/note/comment/attachment requirements
Original client document remains authoritative; summaries and SI actions do not modify it
A closed reviewer comment stays source evidence but does not establish any unrecorded physical quantity
Site+TAG is unique identity, not TAG alone
Price changes prohibited until independent engineering/AVLs/quantity proof and revision approval
Source extracts and SI-derived decisions stored as separate fields
Future MR revisions must create impact review; never silently overwrite previous code/version
